Agent_1_relevancy_explanation: Relevant because it concerns an eco bus station with driver buildings, forecourt and access roads (similar to a bus depot reference project). However, it is in France and focuses on traffic areas, signage and design/construction supervision services rather than large or special structures, therefore medium priority.
titel: Planning services for the implementation of measures A2, A5/A1b, A9 and A11 of the Guyancourt multimodal interchange hub, Line 18 Grand Paris Express
kurzbeschreibung: Planning and construction supervision for bus station, forecourt, access road and passenger information in Guyancourt.
umfang: Implementation of several sub-measures at the multimodal interchange hub of the future Guyancourt/Saint-Quentin-en-Yvelines metro station on Line 18: eco bus station with driver building, secondary access forecourt, access road to the park-and-ride car park as well as signage and passenger information. In addition, design, building permit and construction follow-up for the driver building. No information on spans, GFA or main structural dimensions. A financial framework of 6871897 EUR net is specified for the construction works.
leistungen: General planning engineering and architectural services: preliminary design AVP, updating of the overall AVP, project design PRO, assistance with the award of construction works AMT, review of execution documents VISA, construction supervision DET, scheduling/control/coordination OPC, assistance with acceptance and warranty AOR as well as additional services for utility enquiries and marking, building application and design of the driver building, funding applications and inter-site coordination OPCIC.
relevanzbewertung_erklaerung:
• Not a bridge, roof, stadium or special structure, but predominantly traffic area and infrastructure planning for an interchange hub.
• Does include civil, building and engineering components, but without any apparent demanding structural engineering task or large spans.
• Focus is on VRD, landscape, mobility, coordination and general planning; this only partially matches sbp’s core profile.
• Small to medium construction volume of around 6.9 million EUR net limits the potential fee.
• Strategically at best of interest as a multidisciplinary infrastructure project in the context of the Grand Paris Express, but not a priority for sbp.
honorar_erklaerung: No fee explicitly stated. Comprehensive design and construction supervision services are tendered for several sub-measures of a multimodal transport hub with a construction cost framework of 6871897 EUR net; without precise fee basis, scope split per discipline and national fee regime, no reliable indication for sbp is possible.
referenzen_qualifikationen: A multidisciplinary team or consortium is required with competencies in VRD, landscape architecture, civil engineering, drainage, water management/urban hydraulics, public lighting, mobility, architecture, OPC, OPCIC and coordination of utility providers. The lead partner must mandatorily have VRD competence. Landscape competence must be provided by a landscape architect or paysagiste concepteur/architecte-paysagiste DPLG. Professional qualifications of the assigned staff must be submitted with the offer. Specific qualifications or number of references are defined in the tender documents.
auftraggeber: Saint-Quentin-en-Yvelines - Communauté d'agglomération, 1 rue Eugène-Hénaff, 78192 Trappes, France, Contact: MERCKAERT Lorrain, E-mail: dacp@sqy.fr, Website: http://www.marches-publics.agglo-sqy.fr/
notes: Open procedure. Contract start 01.01.2027, duration 72 months. Electronic submission of tenders required, procedure language French. No framework agreement. Additional information: Part of the financing is provided by Ile de France Mobilités. The notice is published as a competition/standard notice, but in substance it is an award of planning services.
